versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-xhs-public-notes-data:

- Enables keyword-based search of public Xiaohongshu notes, sorted or filtered by likes, comments, favorites, and time.
- Supports fetching note details, comment lists, and creator post histories through clear command options.
- Includes decision-tree usage guide to handle various user inputs (keywords, note links, profile links, shortlinks, or business goals).
- Handles only public Xiaohongshu data—does not support login, publishing, or private content.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access, with guided error handling and troubleshooting.
- Provides extensive documentation, command examples, parameter quick-reference, and compliance boundary clarification.
